fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (failed URLs are not written to the dataset -- they are reported in the ERRORS record of the run's key-value store). Article-mode records (_source S1-html) carry headline/articleBody-style fields parsed from euronews.com ld+json NewsArticle blocks plus HTML body text. Latest-mode records (_source S2-rss, from the /rss feed) carry title/link/pubDate-style fields with a short teaser description instead of full body text.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (article URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-html for article pages, S2-rss for the /rss latest feed, none for errors).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline (article mode; raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle).

description.title: Description
description.description: In article mode, the JSON-LD NewsArticle description. In latest mode (RSS), a short teaser blurb, not the full article text.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description:
Full article text (article mode only), reassembled from direct-child

tags inside div.c-article-content -- subheadings are intentionally dropped.

author.title: Author
author.description: Article mode only. Comma-joined names of the article's Person authors from JSON-LD.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Article mode only. Publisher name resolved from the JSON-LD Organization entry referenced by NewsArticle.publisher.

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: Article mode only. Publication timestamp from JSON-LD NewsArticle.datePublished.

dateModified.title: Date modified
dateModified.description: Article mode only. Last-modified timestamp from JSON-LD NewsArticle.dateModified.

image.title: Image
image.description: Article mode only. Main article image URL, resolved from JSON-LD NewsArticle.image (which may be a plain URL string or an object with a url field).

articleSection.title: Article section
articleSection.description: Article mode only. Section/category name from JSON-LD NewsArticle.articleSection (first entry if the source emits a list).

title.title: Title
title.description: Latest mode (RSS) only. Headline text of the feed item.

link.title: Link
link.description: Latest mode (RSS) only. URL of the feed item's article.

pubDate.title: Publication date
pubDate.description: Latest mode (RSS) only. Raw pubDate string of the feed item.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline (RSS) records.
